defmodule Orchestra.Fleet do
  use Ash.Domain

  resources do
    resource Orchestra.Fleet.Node do
      define :register_node
      define :get_node, action: :get_node, get?: true
      define :list_nodes
    end

    resource Orchestra.Fleet.Rollout do
      define :list_rollouts
    end

    resource Orchestra.Fleet.Placement do
      define :list_placements
    end

    resource Orchestra.Fleet.Approval do
      define :list_approvals
    end

    resource Orchestra.Fleet.Lease do
      define :list_leases
    end

    resource Orchestra.Fleet.Rollout do
      action :plan_rollout, :generic do
        argument :targets, {:array, :map}, allow_nil?: false
        returns :map
        run fn input, _context ->
          targets = input.arguments.targets
          if not is_list(targets) or Enum.empty?(targets) do
            {:error, Ash.Error.Invalid.exception(errors: [
              Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument.exception(field: :targets, message: "targets must be non-empty")
            ])}
          else
            node_names = Enum.map(targets, &get_in(&1, [:node_name]))
            cond do
              Enum.any?(node_names, &(not is_binary(&1))) ->
                {:error, Ash.Error.Invalid.exception(errors: [
                  Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument.exception(field: :targets, message: "each target needs a node_name")

                {:error, Ash.Error.Invalid.exception(errors: [
                  Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument.exception(field: :targets, message: "duplicate node_name")
                ])}
              true ->
                slots_list = Enum.map(targets, &get_in(&1, [:slots]))
                if Enum.any?(slots_list, &(not is_integer(&1) or &1 <= 0)) do

                  }}
                end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end

defmodule Orchestra.Rollout.Steps.DeployNode do
  use Reactor.Step

  def run(_step, %{target: target, rollout_id: rollout_id}, _context) do
    name = target.node_name
    Orchestra.Rollout.Trace.record(:deploy_enter, name)

    # placement created already by reservation step (create)
    node = Orchestra.Fleet.get_node!(name: name)
    placement = hd(Ash.read!(Orchestra.Fleet.Placement, filter: [rollout_id: rollout_id, node_name: name]))

    placement = Ash.update!(placement, attempts: placement.attempts + 1, status: :deploying)

    # min 50ms wall clock per attempt
    Process.sleep(50)

    if node.deploy_failures_remaining > 0 do
      Ash.update!(node, deploy_failures_remaining: node.deploy_failures_remaining - 1)
      Ash.update!(placement, compensations: placement.compensations + 1, status: :reserved)
      Orchestra.Rollout.Trace.record(:deploy_exit, name)
      Orchestra.Rollout.Trace.record(:deploy_compensate, name)
      {:error, {:failed, "would fail"}}
    else
      Ash.update!(placement, status: :deployed)
      Ash.update!(node, state: :live)
      Orchestra.Rollout.Trace.record(:deploy_exit, name)
      {:ok, placement}
    end
  end

  def compensate(_step, _reason, _inputs, _context), do: :ok

  def undo(_step, _reason, %{target: target, rollout_id: rollout_id}, _context) do
    name = target.node_name
    placement = hd(Ash.read!(Orchestra.Fleet.Placement, filter: [rollout_id: rollout_id, node_name: name]))
    if placement.status == :deployed do
      Ash.update!(placement, undos: placement.undos + 1, status: :released)
      Orchestra.Rollout.Trace.record(:deploy_undo, name)
    end
    :ok
  end
end

defmodule Orchestra.Rollout.ApprovalReactor do
  use Reactor

  input :rollout_id
  input :total_slots
  input :board_threshold

  step :level do
    switch [input: :total_slots, input: :board_threshold] do
      match n when n >= val -> :board
      match _ -> :auto
    end
  end

  step :create_approval, input: :level do
    resource_create Orchestra.Fleet.Approval, :create, arguments: [%{
      rollout_id: :rollout_id,
      level: :level,
      slots: :total_slots
    }]
  end

  return :create_approval
end

defmodule Orchestra.Rollout.Reactor do
  use Reactor

  input :rollout_name
  input :strategy
  input :targets
  input :board_threshold

  middleware Orchestra.Rollout.Middleware

  step :plan, input: :targets do
    resource_action Orchestra.Fleet.Rollout, :plan_rollout, arguments: [%{targets: :targets}]
  end

  step :hold_lease, input: :rollout_name do
    resource_create Orchestra.Fleet.Lease, :create, arguments: [%{rollout_name: :rollout_name}]
  end

  step :create_rollout, input: :rollout_name, input: :strategy do
    resource_create Orchestra.Fleet.Rollout, :create, arguments: [%{name: :rollout_name, strategy: :strategy}]
  end

  step :reserve_capacity, input: :create_rollout, input: :plan do
    # reserve sequentially to handle capacity and fail clean; then map deploy
    run fn _, %{create_rollout: rollout, plan: plan} ->
      Enum.reduce_while(plan.node_names, {:ok, []}, fn name, {:ok, reservations} ->
        node = Orchestra.Fleet.get_node!(name: name)
        slots = (plan.targets |> Enum.find(& &1.node_name == name)).slots
        if node.slots_used + slots > node.slots_total do
          {:halt, {:error, :insufficient_capacity}}
        else
          Ash.update!(node, slots_used: node.slots_used + slots, state: :reserved)
          placement = Ash.create!(Orchestra.Fleet.Placement, %{rollout_id: rollout.id, node_name: name, slots: slots})
          {:cont, {:ok, [placement | reservations]}}
        end
      end)
    end
    compensate fn _, _, _, _ -> undo_reservations() end
    undo fn _, _, _, _ -> undo_reservations()
  end
  step :approve, input: [:create_rollout, :plan], input: :board_threshold do
    compose Orchestra.Rollout.ApprovalReactor, %{rollout_id: :create_rollout.id, total_slots: :plan.total_slots, board_threshold: :board_threshold}
  end

  step :deploy, input: :targets, input: :create_rollout, max_concurrency: 2 do
    map :targets, :target, %{rollout_id: :create_rollout.id} do
      step :deploy_node, Orchestra.Rollout.Steps.DeployNode
    end
  end

  return :create_rollout
  
  defp undo_reservations do
    # reversed in cleanup; separate since reserve is non-retryable and must be undone on run failure
    :ok
  end
end

  input :strategy

  end

  step :hold_lease, input: :rollout_name do
    Reactor.Step.ResourceCreate.run Orchestra.Fleet.Lease, :create, arguments: [%{rollout_name: :rollout_name}]
  end

  step :create_rollout, input: :rollout_name, input: :strategy do
    Reactor.Step.ResourceCreate.run Orchestra.Fleet.Rollout, :create, arguments: [%{name: :rollout_name, strategy: :strategy}]
  end

  step :reserve_capacity, input: :create_rollout, input: :plan do
    run fn _, %{create_rollout: rollout, plan: plan} ->
      {reservations, _} = Enum.reduce(plan.node_names, {[], []}, fn name, {rs, undone} ->
        node = Orchestra.Fleet.get_node!(name: name)

        {:error, :insufficient_capacity}
      else

      end
    end
    compensate fn _, _, _, _ -> undo_reservations() end
